newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums steady in thinly-talked market.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums steady in thinly-talked market.

text.p: European jet fuel premiums held steady on Thursday, while outright prices climbed as underlying gas oil futures gained $2.00 a tonne.
The cargo market was thinly talked but premiums were notionally unchanged at around June IPE gas oil +$18.00-$19.00 cif NWE.
Prompt fob avails were non-existent with U.K. refiners planning to hold onto supplies at Milford Haven until at least next week, traders said.
The barge market was quiet after several parcels changed hands at June IPE +$16.50 a tonne fob ARA on Wednesday.
June IPE gas oil futures were trading $2.00 higher at $178.25 a tonne at 1533 GMT.
